A table that needs its cells
wrapped below 100 columns:

▎ Setting
▎    width 
▎ What it does
▎   The column width the
▎   document is laid out for,
▎   in cells.
▎ Default
▎   80

▎ Setting
▎    theme 
▎ What it does
▎   Colours and glyphs:
▎   bullets, check boxes, the
▎   quote bar, and the code
▎   style.
▎ Default
▎   dark

▎ Setting
▎    caps 
▎ What it does
▎   What the terminal can do:
▎   kitty graphics, text
▎   sizing and the cell size
▎   in pixels.
▎ Default
▎   none

Inline content and an escaped
pipe:

╭──────────┬─────────────────╮
│ Syntax   │ Example         │
├──────────┼─────────────────┤
│ link     │ example         │
│ code     │  a | b          │
│ emphasis │ soft and strong │
╰──────────┴─────────────────╯

Emoji with a variation
selector:

│ Icon │ Meaning   │
├──────┼───────────┤
│ ❤️   │ love      │
│ ✔️   │ done      │
│ 👍🏽   │ thumbs up │
╰──────┴───────────╯
